name: sidecaramel
description: Read and inspect Serato DJ Pro metadata — cues, loops, BPM, beatgrids, FLIP, .crate and .serato-stems — with confirm-gated writers.
long_description:
Exposes the sidecaramel toolkit over MCP: read parsed Serato tags (Markers2, Markers_ V1, BeatGrid, Autotags, Analysis, Overview, FLIP), inventory the raw blobs, inspect .serato-stems sidecars, and list Serato crates/databases. Write tools (overview render, stems sidecar, blob wipe, library consolidate) are confirm-gated and fail closed while Serato is running.

Cross-platform via the uv runtime: the host provisions Python and the dependencies automatically, so nothing needs to be pip-installed by hand.

tools.name: serato_track_metadata
tools.description: Read parsed Serato metadata (BPM, cues, loops, colors, FLIP) from an audio file.

tools.name: serato_blob_inventory
tools.description: List the raw Serato tag blobs embedded in an audio file.

tools.name: serato_library_tracks
tools.description: List the tracks referenced by a Serato crate or database.

tools.name: serato_library_format
tools.description: Detect the format of a Serato library or database file.

tools.name: serato_render_overview
tools.description: Render a waveform overview PNG for an audio file (writes a file).

tools.name: serato_extract_stems
tools.description: Extract stems from a .serato-stems file to WAVs (writes files).

tools.name: serato_write_overview
tools.description: Write a Serato Overview waveform blob into an audio file (gated).

tools.name: serato_build_stems_sidecar
tools.description: Build a .serato-stems sidecar from stem audio (gated).

tools.name: serato_wipe_blobs
tools.description: Remove Serato tag blobs from an audio file (gated, needs confirmation).

tools.name: serato_library_consolidate
tools.description: Consolidate Serato library entries across volumes (gated, needs confirmation).

prompts.name: inspect_track
prompts.description: Summarise a track's Serato metadata (BPM, cues, loops).
prompts.text: Read the Serato metadata for ${arguments.audio_path} and summarise its BPM, cue points and loops.

prompts.name: list_blobs
prompts.description: List the raw Serato tag blobs embedded in a file.
prompts.text: List every Serato tag blob embedded in ${arguments.audio_path} with its byte size.

prompts.name: library_tracks
prompts.description: List tracks from a Serato database V2 file.
prompts.text: List the first 20 tracks in the Serato database at ${arguments.db_path}.
